title: Q90 operator-size family persistence and strict-prior anticipation
hypothesis: The recent 100-target mean Top-5 hit share of a Q90 formula family predicts its next-target family-average Top-5 hit share, allowing a rolling family selector to exceed an equal-family ensemble by at least 0.005 on the chronological Blind OOS.

source.q90_feature_selection: 20 features selected on Q90 Discovery only; frozen for Validation and Blind OOS

formula_universe.sampling: Within each family, select the 100 formula IDs with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 of 'Q141-B7|' concatenated with formula_id. Sampling is independent of target outcomes and formula performance.

formula_types.linear_mean: mean of the formula's 4–8 feature columns, computed in float64 and rounded to 12 decimals
formula_types.pairwise_interaction: four-feature mean plus 0.25 times z-score of one pairwise feature product across 40 candidates; score rounded to 12 decimals
formula_types.conditional_gate: four-feature mean plus 0.25 times indicator(gate feature >= registered threshold); score rounded to 12 decimals

formula_universe.ranking: Higher score ranks first; ties resolve to lower number ID first, matching Q90 rank_actuals.

walkforward.selector: For target t, select the family with the highest mean family Top-5 hit share over targets [t-100,t); update history only after scoring target t. Tie-break lexicographically by family ID.
walkforward.warmup: For the first 100 targets, use equal-family mean; warmup outcomes may enter later prior windows only after they are scored.
walkforward.family_target_outcome: For each target and family, average the Top-5 hit share over that family's 100 preselected formulas.
walkforward.equal_family_baseline: Unweighted mean of the seven family target outcomes.
walkforward.static_baseline: Select the family with the highest mean family target outcome over Discovery only; freeze for Validation and Blind OOS; tie-break lexicographically.
walkforward.current_target_outcome_use: Scoring and state update only after family choice and all formula rankings are frozen for that target.
walkforward.discovery_interpretation: Descriptive/in-sample because the 20-feature Q90 subset was selected on Discovery.
walkforward.validation_blind_interpretation: Chronological holdouts relative to Q90 feature selection; historical Blind OOS is exposed SONAR research history, not virgin prospective evidence.

primary_endpoint.decision: No lift unless point estimate >= 0.005, two-sided 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes zero in the positive direction, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05.

statistical_plan.sign_flip: 20,000 Monte Carlo non-overlapping chronological block sign-flips, one-sided positive alternative
statistical_plan.bootstrap: 20,000 circular moving-block bootstrap replicates, percentile 95% CI
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across rolling-vs-equal-family and Discovery-static-vs-equal-family contrasts in each of Discovery, Validation and Blind OOS.

controls: Verify artifact ZIP SHA-256 and all 17 internal member SHA-256 values against the independently read-back manifest.
Verify Q90 feature matrix archive blob, dimensions, dtype, finite values, target dates and cutoff dates.
Verify actual quintets and target order against the Q90 target ledger.
Verify 700 sampled formula IDs are unique, deterministic and exactly 100 per family.
Reproduce Q90 scoring semantics including 12-decimal rounding, pair-product z-score over 40 candidates and tie order.
Verify current target is not used in selector state and state updates only after target scoring.
Run future-suffix and target-outcome invariance tests.
No formula or family selection may use Validation or Blind OOS outcomes.
Report all six registered comparisons and Holm-adjusted p-values.
limitations: The sample covers 700 of 330,429 Q90 formulas, not the complete formula universe.
Q90's 20-feature subset was selected on Discovery from 59 features; Discovery is therefore descriptive/in-sample.
The feature matrix archive ends 2026-11-07 and does not use the later Q141 eligible archive rows.
Historical Blind OOS is exposed research history, not virgin prospective evidence.
Family mean Top-5 hit share is a meta-research diagnostic, not a deployable single-number ranking or five-number forecast.
This Holm family covers six registered Q141-B7 tests, not all historical SONAR experiments.
next_action: Execute the deterministic 700-formula family sample and strict-prior rolling selector; persist complete target ledger, report, manifest and checkpoint with exact hashes.
